_notes: Taito do Brasil, 1980 firmware (three 2KB ROMs, the third mirrored). Compiled 2026-10 by evilwraith from the
Drakor ROM, saved images of Drakor and Meteor, and a live Drakor capture on an AtGames ALP4K (Visual Pinball
Standalone): a full game read back its final score of 30,671 and two credits exactly, with ball, player count,
current player and game-over behaving as on the 1981-85 boards. Same layout as vortex.map.json; the reset path
differs (it clamps an out-of-range ball or credits digit rather than declaring game over). 0x408E cycles 0-9
during play (match randomiser). obaoba / obaoba1 share the generation but have not been checked against an image.

player_count._notes: Read seven times by Drakor's code; 1 throughout a live one-player game, 0 in attract.
player_count.label: Players

current_player._notes: 0 in attract, 1 during a one-player game; the reset path requires it non-zero to resume a game.
current_player.label: Current Player

credits._notes: Stored value; the firmware copies it to the display at 0x408D at boot (LDA 407F / STA 408D).
credits.label: Credits

game_over._notes: Bit 0 of the firmware's flags byte: set in attract and by its reset path when it declines to resume, clear during a game.
game_over.label: Game Over

score._notes: Most-significant byte first, unlike the display; the reset path reloads it from the ROM's minimum if it reads lower.
